notes: card edit cancel/backdrop close is handled in the final capture layer so older mobile listeners cannot swallow the action

avatar and cover can be selected directly from the phone gallery/files and are stored in the same card avatar/avatarOriginal and cover/coverOriginal fields used by PC backups
image changes remain draft-only until Change Save is pressed; Cancel discards them
the editor sheet is raised above the fixed bottom navigation and bottom navigation pointer events are disabled while editing
global theme parity from v0.2.1 remains enabled
PC backup JSON import/export remains compatible
